title: REQ · The Boy's Room scene content and asset folders live outside the engine
summary: Scene, location and manifest content under src/content/worlds/the-boys-room plus the asset folder tree
description: Context: world content is YAML in game/content and hotspots are hardcoded. Desired behavior: a manifest.json and scene definition (bookshelf, computer, bed, window, door) under game/src/content/worlds/the-boys-room, and the public asset folder tree with .gitkeep files. Why: AI agents edit content, not engine.
acceptance_criteria: Given the-boys-room manifest and scene files, When parsed with the R1 schemas, Then both are valid
Given the scene objects, When listing their asset ids, Then every id exists in the manifest
Given the repo, When checking game/public/assets, Then all required folders exist
